annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 349/2024 - Institui campanha de prevenção e combate aos crimes digitais contra crianças, adolescentes e pessoas com deficiência praticados com o suporte de ferramentas de inteligência artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 349/2024 - Establishing a campaign to prevent and combat digital crimes against children, adolescents and persons with disabilities committed with the support of artificial intelligence tools
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies bill establishing a public awareness and prevention campaign against AI-enabled digital crimes (e.g., deepfake child sexual content) targeting children, adolescents and persons with disabilities. It funds the campaign via the Diffuse Rights Fund and amends the Child and Adolescent Statute and the Disability Statute.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates a national campaign against AI-assisted digital crimes targeting children, adolescents and persons with disabilities.
Trains educators to identify unlawful conduct involving misuse of AI.
Funding from the Diffuse Rights Fund, federal budget, agreements and donations.
Amends ECA art. 70-A and adds art. 92-A to the Statute of Persons with Disabilities.
Allows Union partnerships with states, municipalities and non-profits; regulation to follow.
